title: Raakaasa OTT Release Details: What You Need to Know About Niharika Konidela’s Horror Fantasy Film

description: Scientists have solved a 66-million-year climate mystery, explaining how Earth cooled from a tropical greenhouse to an ice-capped world. New research reveals ocean calcium levels dropped by more than half, reshaping marine chemistry. As calcium declined, oceans locked away more carbon dioxide, lowering atmospheric CO2. The study links deep-Earth processes, ocean evolution, and marine life to long-term global climate change across geological timescales recorded in fossils and ancient seafloor rocks.
title: Sinking Calcium Carbonate Locked Away Greenhouse Gases, Reveals New Study

title: Sarvam Maya Set for OTT Release on JioHotstar: All You Need to Know About Nivin Pauly’s Horror Comedy

description: Europa, one of Jupiter’s icy moons, may have a more habitable ocean than once thought. New simulations show that dense, salt-rich ice on the surface can slowly sink through the moon’s thick ice shell and drip into the hidden ocean below. This process would deliver nutrients and oxidants over geological timescales, potentially sustaining conditions favourable for extraterrestrial life beneath Europa’s frozen crust.
title: Europa’s Hidden Ocean Could Be ‘Fed’ by Sinking Salted Ice; New Study Boosts Hopes for Alien Life

description: A passport is an important government-issued document that not only comes in handy while travelling abroad, but also when you are required to produce a photo identity card. You can get a passport issued via the Passport Seva online portal after filling out an application form. However, you also need to visit a Passport Seva Kendra, which is allotted based on your current residence, where you need to get your documents verified. However, to schedule an appointment, you are first required to pay a fee.
title: Passport Appointment Online: How to Book, Documents Required, Track Status, and More

description: Some physicists argue our universe may be just one bubble in a much larger multiverse. Inflation theory suggests countless universes can form, each with different physical laws, while quantum mechanics allows branching realities. This idea could explain why cosmic constants appear finely tuned for life. However, other universes may be fundamentally unobservable, leaving the multiverse an intriguing but still unproven scientific possibility.
title: Scientists Search the Big Bang’s Afterglow for Signs of Colliding Parallel Universes

description: WhatsApp’s AI Stickers feature allows you to create personalised Republic Day 2026 stickers instead of sharing generic forwards. title: How to Create AI Stickers on WhatsApp for Customised Republic Day 2026 Wishes: A Step-by-Step Guide
